sections.text_helper: Section 39.6.14 "RTC timestamp subsecond register (RTC_TSSSR)" in chapter 39 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1586.
sections.section_content:
The content of this register is valid only when TSF is set to 1 in RTC_SR. It is cleared when
the TSF bit is reset.
This register can be protected against unprivileged access. Refer to Section39.3.4: RTC
privilege protection modes.
Address offset: 0x38
RTC domain reset value: 0x0000 0000
System reset: not affected
Bits 31:0 SS[31:0]: Subsecond value/synchronous binary counter values
SS[31:0] is the value of the synchronous prescaler counter when the timestamp event
occurred.

fields.name: SS[31:0]
